provenance: Two independent annotator identifiers and user-provided subsequent corrections; *_assembled.json is an explicitly traced composite, not a fresh browser export. Original exports and intermediate revisions are retained privately.
adjudication: Compare the two labels on their 24 exact sequence:frame IDs; 14 person pairs have IoU >= 0.75, 10 pairs both have no person, no attribute conflict. Use latest team_1 primary boxes for all 115 evaluation frames without detector-assisted edits.
detector_selection: torchvision SSDLite320 MobileNetV3 Large COCO_V1, pinned in stage8_v1a_a2_preannotation.json before human labels
attribute_scope: truncated/occluded/uncertain attributes are provenance-only in this first 2D evaluation; 15 primary boxes touch a 640x480 image edge while truncated=false, so no attribute-based stratification is permitted without further human review.
evaluation_scope: Two brief visually similar Bonn RGB-D laboratory sequences; second sequence has been examined during human QC, so label review was not blind. No claim of cross-scene generalization, real danger-zone recognition, D435 or Jetson measurements, or early accident prediction.
revision_policy: Any post-inference label change gets a new version, recorded reason, and a full recomputation; original frozen numbers remain auditable. Detector outputs cannot arbitrate human labels.
